objective: Acquire real anonymous game starts and retained players, not social impressions or raw clicks.

guardrails.aiDisclosure: Accurately disclose generative AI use wherever platform rules require; never conceal AI use to evade moderation.
guardrails.externalPosts: Never auto-submit to an unapproved subreddit or forum. Verify current community rules and moderation precedents before a one-off human-approved post.
guardrails.bulkPosts: Do not submit seven launch announcements at once or repost to circumvent deletion.
guardrails.lowValueCampaigns: Do not create new routine promotion on paused channels; already scheduled posts are not proof of publication or acquisition.
guardrails.qualityGate: Only one individually reviewed CrazyGames candidate; Poki after quality, originality and first-time-player tests.
guardrails.conversionMetric: Prioritize start_events and completed_runs, not views, likes, or follows.
guardrails.stopRule: After at least 14 days and 3 distinct posts per test channel, stop if no attributed game starts, unless data ingestion was unavailable.
guardrails.blueskyAccount: Only the new `morrowwishgames` Bluesky identity may be promoted. Metricool still connects old `ruckusbutton.bsky.social`; do not publish until new account is connected. Existing seven old-account posts are drafts, not auto-published.
guardrails.socialCrossposting: YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels are active P2 tests. Reuse the same approved gameplay clips and measure native views separately from first-party website visits and game starts. Facebook crossposting is optional only if a connected authorized business Page and no extra asset production.

channels.name: CrazyGames
channels.reason: Native browser-game audience; existing submission rejected for quality; reapply only after gameplay QA.

channels.name: itch.io
channels.reason: All seven games live; improve discoverability, honest AI disclosure, thumbnails and first 30 seconds rather than mass relisting.

channels.name: itch.io Release Announcements
channels.reason: Explicit self-promotion board; image/video plus genuine game description required; space out posts.

channels.name: Poki
channels.reason: AI tools can be used thoughtfully; strict originality/playtest requirements; only after proven game quality.

channels.name: YouTube Shorts
channels.reason: Test with direct tracked links and game starts; video views alone are not a success signal.

channels.name: TikTok
channels.reason: Same limited test and attribution requirements as Shorts.

channels.name: Google / Bing
channels.reason: Sitemap/IndexNow maintenance only; do not spend time on repetitive promotion.

channels.name: Instagram
channels.reason: New Reels already earn organic exposure (Metricool: six reels, 273 views in observed period). Reuse the same gameplay clips as Shorts/TikTok; evaluate attributable game starts before expanding effort.

channels.name: Bluesky
channels.reason: Indie game and creative audiences; test tracked links on the new studio account, not the retired ruckusbutton identity. Native post view counts (beta) are owner-only, not public API analytics.

channels.name: Reddit
channels.reason: AI restrictions and self-promotion enforcement vary by subreddit; no automatically generated submission links until individually approved.

blocked.name: Newgrounds
blocked.reason: Official game guidelines discourage prompt-generated games and warn AI-dependent submissions may be removed.

blocked.name: r/playmygame
blocked.reason: Does not allow fully AI-generated games; excludes games with substantial generative AI.

blocked.name: r/Games
blocked.reason: Promotion account-history restrictions make a new promotional studio account high risk.

blocked.name: r/IndieGaming
blocked.reason: GenAI disclosure and self-promotion enforcement; skip until explicit eligibility confirmed.
